subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should OpenClaw add native backup exclude-pattern controls now, and what defaults/protected paths should be part of that core CLI contract?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but defaults, ignore-file loading, and protected recovery paths decide the tradeoff between smaller safer archives and restorable backups.

options.title: Review linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON compatibility, conflicts, and proof before landing or narrowing it.

options.title: Narrow to explicit custom excludes
options.body: Accept only `--exclude` and `--exclude-file` first while deferring smart defaults and auto-loaded ignore behavior until restore and security expectations are clearer.

options.title: Decline native excludes for now
options.body: Keep core backups coarse and document plugin or ClawHub alternatives after an explicit maintainer decision that native exclusions are outside the current core boundary.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON compatibility, conflicts, and proof before landing or narrowing it.

likelyOwner.reason: gumadeiras merged the original backup CLI PR and has the strongest history signal for the current backup contract decision.
